Prepare a small permitted image crop

Private prototype, not release-qualified. Choose a correction sidecar and a PNG page raster already on your device. No original is uploaded or changed. For multi-gigabyte documents, first create a permitted page raster outside this tool. Do not select confidential or personal records.

PNG input only: at most 20 MiB, 8192 pixels per side and 16 megapixels total. Crop: at most 512 pixels per side, 131072 pixels total and one quarter of the page. Output PNG at most 64 KiB; packet at most 100 KiB. Browser decoding and canvas colour conversion can change raster pixels; this is a derivative, not original evidence bytes.
